answer: Reputation decays 12% per epoch without a submission and one duplicate answer forfeits the whole balance. Failure mode, an operator clones an answer across 50 accounts, all 50 balances go to zero in one close, and the funding wallet becomes visible. At 12% decay an idle identity keeps 21% of its score after 12 epochs, so parking accounts costs more than answering. The orchard has to keep producing, and a zephyr of fresh registrations cannot rebuild score faster than the gale of decay strips it.
